name: Machine text refused over the outward-text cases
purpose: offline cases of texts one outward write would send: the 2026-11-16 subject (a header label and an id), a header on its own line, ids in a body, one id repeated, a persona id, and readable texts including links that carry ids. The id shapes and header labels are fixed in code, and no case checks that a name written in place of an id is the right one.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of the live implementation on the rule's cases, recorded as a row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash; a rule holds or does not, so the implementations are never ranked.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the readable_guard offline arm of write_in_names runs the whole case set with no model call] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read: esoi run write_in_names --impl readable_guard --only WN-001 --max-calls 0]
